title: Matt Pocock's skills: the agent skills a real engineer actually uses every day
description:
Most Claude Code prompts are kitchen-sink files that give the AI too much room to overthink. Matt Pocock's skills repo is the opposite. Small, sharp, single-purpose primitives for TDD, GitHub triage, and breaking architecture into vertical slices. controlled vocabulary via a LANGUAGE.md that defines exact architectural terms with strict warnings preventing synonym substitution. Forces the AI to act like a precision tool, not a rambling chatbot.

https://github.com/mattpocock/skills

#github #opensource
